body_en: Police: 110. Fire and ambulance: 119. Both work from any phone.
body_zh: 報警：110。消防和救護車：119。任何電話都能撥打。

title_en: No eating or drinking on the MRT
body_en: Past the yellow line at the ticket gates, eating, drinking (even water) and chewing gum are banned and can be fined. Finish your bubble tea before the gate.
body_zh: 過了閘門的黃線之後，禁止吃東西、喝東西（連水也不行）和嚼口香糖，違者可能被罰款。珍奶請在進站前喝完。

body_en: The dark blue seats on trains and buses are for the elderly, pregnant passengers and people with disabilities. Many locals leave them empty even when the train is full.
body_zh: 捷運和公車上的深藍色座位是給長者、孕婦和行動不便的人。很多人即使車廂客滿也會讓它空著。

body_en: A stored-value card for MRT, buses, YouBike and convenience stores. Buy and top it up at MRT stations or any 7-Eleven / FamilyMart.
body_zh: 儲值卡，可以搭捷運、公車、YouBike，也能在便利商店付款。在捷運站或任何 7-Eleven、全家都能購買和加值。

body_en: 7-Eleven and FamilyMart sell hot food and drinks, top up cards, have ATMs, print documents and pay bills. There is one on almost every corner.
body_zh: 7-Eleven 和全家有熱食和飲料，可以加值、提款、列印文件、繳費，幾乎每個街角都有一家。

body_en: Night market stalls, small eateries and traditional shops are often cash only. Cards work in malls, chains and most hotels.
body_zh: 夜市攤販、小吃店和傳統店家常常只收現金。百貨、連鎖店和大部分飯店可以刷卡。

body_en: Tipping is not expected. Sit-down restaurants may add a 10% service charge to the bill.
body_zh: 台灣沒有給小費的習慣。坐著用餐的餐廳可能會在帳單上加收 10% 服務費。

body_en: Public trash bins are rare. Keep a small bag for your trash; convenience stores and MRT stations usually have bins. Garbage trucks play classical music (often Für Elise) so residents know to come out.
body_zh: 路上很少有垃圾桶，隨身帶個小袋子裝垃圾；便利商店和捷運站通常有。垃圾車會播放古典音樂（常常是〈給愛麗絲〉），提醒居民出來倒垃圾。

body_en: Locals boil or filter tap water. Many stations, museums and hotels have free filtered water dispensers, so bring a bottle.
body_zh: 台灣人會把自來水煮開或過濾後再喝。很多車站、博物館和飯店有免費的飲水機，帶個水壺就好。

body_en: Step over the raised door threshold, never on it. Facing the temple, enter through the right-hand (dragon) door and leave through the left-hand (tiger) door. Ask before photographing people praying.
body_zh: 跨過門檻，不要踩在門檻上。面對廟門，從右邊（龍門）進、左邊（虎門）出。拍攝正在拜拜的人之前先詢問。

body_en: Scooters are everywhere and turning vehicles do not always yield to pedestrians, even on a green light. Look both ways twice. Sidewalks under shop arcades can be uneven.
body_zh: 機車到處都是，轉彎的車輛不一定會禮讓行人，即使是綠燈也一樣。過馬路前多看兩次。騎樓下的人行道可能高低不平。

body_en: At MRT platforms people wait in lines marked on the floor beside the doors and let passengers off first.
body_zh: 捷運月台上，大家會在車門兩側地上標示的線排隊，先讓車上的人下車。
